correctness.rationale: The bijection sends a matching edge (i,j) of the triangular half-graph to increasing arc i→j+1, so all matchings are disjoint unions of sorted directed paths and correspond bijectively to set partitions of [n+1]. The involution reverses ground-set order. A reversal-stable partition decomposes into self-reversed blocks on t reflected label pairs, with (2t−1) arcs and sign (−1)^(t−1), or pairs of exchanged blocks on t pairs with 2^(t−1) choices, (2t−2) arcs and sign (−1)^(t−1). For odd ground size, the center block on t pairs adds sign (−1)^t y^(2t). The labeled exponential formula therefore gives T_(2m−1)=m![z^m]exp((1−e^(−y²z))/y+(1−e^(−2y²z))/(2y²)) and T_(2m) with e^(−y²z) factor. Augmented Hopf trace yields reduced Lefschetz −T_n(−1); quotient Euler follows averaging ordinary and invariant-cell Euler numbers. Independent direct matching enumeration and independent component recurrence match all coefficients for n=1..7 (not only y=−1), while the bijection proves all n.
residual_risks: No individual-degree homology character follows merely from alternating Lefschetz trace; quotient Euler does not determine quotient homotopy.
